metadata.title: Bir Bikram Kishor Manikya - Tripura's Indigenous history | एक आदिवासी राजा की उपेक्षित समाधी
metadata.description: In the heart of Agartala, the capital city of Tripura, lies a forgotten gem that holds significant historical and cultural value for the Indigenous people of the state. The royal cremation ground, where the Samadhi of the last king, Bir Bikram Kishor Manikya, rests, stands as a testament to the rich heritage of Tripura. Despite claims by Prime Minister Modi and State Chief Minister Manik Shah that the king was not given due respect by earlier governments, locals assert that this sacred site has been neglected for years. Join us as we delve into our ground report to shed light on this hidden treasure and explore its untapped potential as a tourist attraction.
